secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign and verify JWTs. Generate a long random string.

secrets.name: EMAIL_HOST
secrets.description: SMTP server hostname (e.g. smtp.gmail.com). Optional — only needed for email notifications.

secrets.name: EMAIL_PORT
secrets.description: SMTP server port (587 or 465). Optional — only needed for email notifications.

secrets.name: EMAIL_USER
secrets.description: SMTP username. Optional — only needed for email notifications.

secrets.name: EMAIL_PASS
secrets.description: SMTP password / app password. Optional — only needed for email notifications.

secrets.name: EMAIL_FROM
secrets.description: Sender email address. Optional — only needed for email notifications.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
secrets.description: Cloudinary cloud name. Optional — only needed for upload features.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudinary API key. Optional — only needed for upload features.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET
secrets.description: Cloudinary API secret. Optional — only needed for upload features.
